description: This file provides utility functions for resolving global singleton instances and global maps using symbols as keys, primarily for process-local caches and registries. It handles storage in the global scope and ensures single creation of instances.

methods.name: export function resolveGlobalSingleton<T>(key: symbol, create: () => T): T { resolveGlobalSingleton
methods.description: Resolves or creates a singleton instance in the global scope associated with a symbol key. It reuses the existing instance if present, otherwise creates and stores a new one.

methods.description: Provides a singleton Map instance associated with a symbol key in the global scope, utilizing resolveGlobalSingleton for creation.
